run_gtest_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a specified command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_help_flag_full: test that gtest prints help message when --help flag is specified
test_help_flag_short: test that gtest prints help message when -h short flag is specified
test_help_flag_question: test that gtest prints help message when -? question flag is specified
test_help_flag_windows: test that gtest prints help message when /? Windows-style flag is specified
